evidence_quotes: Valmet selected for Louisiana Green Fuels carbon-negative power project
Valmet was selected by Strategic Biofuels to provide biomass power generation and flue gas cleaning technologies for its Louisiana Green Fuels (LGF) development project in Caldwell Parish, Louisiana.
data.reason: The text reports that Valmet was selected as a technology partner to provide biomass power generation and flue gas cleaning technologies for a major project.
